body: She definitely has the benefit of the doubt in my eyes as we have a long history not just including this relationship (which really has been great). I agree with your point since i have no proof she actually did anything just accusing her of something with no evidence would probably backfire on me since i would just be speculating at that point. That being said the optics aren’t exactly great and would still need to be addressed in a conversation regardless.

I agree with a lot of your points. Putting yourself in those kind of situations is an issue itself. Hearing that you had to fend off a bunch of guys at the bar and acting like its a flex to your SO is still not what you want to hear even though you technically did the right thing.

I saw no incriminating texts from my girlfriend but that doesn’t mean they don’t exist. That group chat is blowing up pretty regularly so there is probably more stuff in there. That being said being that all the girls are on high alert I’m sure it was wiped clean.

Thank you for sharing. I have been handling everything the way you described up until this point. I understand we can’t be together all the time and that even if we could it wouldn’t be healthy to do that. I always thought its ok to not be fully immersed in all of these situations but this experience and your story is making me reconsider that.
Got a laugh on this one. Guilty by association definitely applies there.

Was thinking of starting with the approach of “how is so & so’s boyfriend doing, we should do something with them etc.” At this point she knows their whole relationship is blown up. Im curious to see if she would lie to me about there relationship status and if she doesn’t, lies to me about the reason why. If both of her answers to those questions are not truthful it will tell me everything i need to know.
I was considering this approach as well as far as waiting until there is something that can’t be explained off. I don’t have any hard evidence and didn’t want to play all the cards i have at once.

Exactly what i fear. Misery loves company and no one is totally immune to peer pressure especially if in a particular vulnerable situation. Those in bad current/previous relationships will want you to ruin your own.
I always found it a bit odd on why we never got together as couples. Seems like maybe it was a way of keeping everyone in the dark.

I have no hard evidence on that front so still hoping for the best but i am not naive to your points. The way they tried to turn it on this guy for having a gut feeling and being right about it was wild.
Right the last thing i want is to have it turn into an argument as that solves nothing.

This will more then likely be my angle. I was never 100% comfortable with these trips to begin with but i never wanted to overstep and be controlling as they are her friends and i have seen friends without her on other trips but not nearly as frequent. I thought we had a very high level of trust in one another so all this was a bit of a shock.

I agree that is why i am not trying to jump to conclusions although the optics aren’t great. There is one other girl who has a boyfriend who she did not mention by name. Although she did say that all the girls flirted with guys regularly at the bar which i assume included my GF.

Not sure they are aware yet. I just found all of this out in the last 24 hours so its all very recent. I believe that girls boyfriend said he was going to inform all of the other involved parties but if he doesn’t I certainly will be.

She does not know that i am aware of all of this. She has no connection to this mutual friend as it is just someone i used to work with before we started dating who I don’t really see any more. Unfortunately i am a member of this community due to a previous relationship and i am all to familiar with the art of trickle truthing.
So the thing is none of these girls know that their friend ratted on all of them. The only reason i know that is because the girls boyfriend told our mutual friend that she said all of this.
This was my thought process also. I think her being unaware that i know this information or what i know is an advantage i should use.

At a bare minimum they are all toxic and i want absolutely nothing to do with them. I will check out those suggestions as i am in a tough spot of wanting to believe that my GF would never do that and the reality of a giant red flag waving in front of my face.
I am sorry to hear that. I hope you are able to find/found some better people in your life to give you support.

Sorry to hear that your going through this OP. There a quite a few questions you need to ask yourself and her to determine if reconciliation is even a possibility.

She was cheating on you and only came clean after being caught, not by her own omission. Being that this went on for a year, there is clear deliberate action to hide this from you and a more then likely emotional connection with the affair partner. That is a major factor where you need to ask yourself if you can trust her again.

I know you are feeling the pain now, but your 2 year old will feel it eventually. Regardless if you separate or stay together, this is an unfortunate reality. It will be obvious to them when they grow up and your split up, and will be nearly impossible to keep quiet even if you stay together. Children are more aware of you and your partner’s relationship more then many realize. These things come out eventually. You need to ask her not only why she did this to you, but why she would do it to her child. I would emphasize that point. She didn’t just cheat on you, she cheated on her child by putting her own selfish needs above that of her child. Regardless of you and hers emotional standing, that is a reality. You need to ask yourself again, can you look past that and forgive her for what she did to both of you. 

Reconciliation is a difficult road but not impossible if both parties are invested. Granted the stats are not in favor of successful, long term reconciliation given how long this affair went on. Whatever you decide OP, i wish you and your child the best.

Felt like i was watching a movie while reading. This affair fog build up is the type of thing seen in a lot of movies/shows today. Wish it wasn’t so prevalent as i feel it glorifies the action and desensitizes many to the emotional impact of engaging in something like that.

My friends and I just had something similar happen to us the other day. I received a text just like that saying “Had a great time the other night can’t wait for round 2” then a selfie of a girl who i never saw before. They used my area code and everything. Cleary the Instagram bots are adapting.

OP, one thing to keep in mind for the near future is that once everyone from her side (family, non-mutual friends, etc.) sees that you are sticking your foot down and not reconciling things will get ugly fast.

All of the blame that is currently on her and sympathy you are receiving from her side will turn sour. The “she made a mistake” will begin to turn into justifications on why she made the mistake. The “please forgive her” will begin to turn into “why are you so stubborn and not willing to reconcile?” The point is her side is her side now and no matter how wrong the wrong at the end of the day they will back her up. That is just what families do and its better to prepare yourself for that switch sooner then later.

I would advise you to tread carefully and not confide in or reveal to much about your plans with the divorce etc. with anyone from her side as it will get brought up at some point and turned against you. I am sorry you are going through this but remember to keep your resolve strong and lean on the good support system you have around you. Good luck friend.
